description: When you need a password, API key or token from the user, call this instead of asking them to paste it into chat. Returns a link for the user; they paste the value on that page, where it's encrypted in their browser to a key that only exists on this machine. Give the user the link and END YOUR TURN so they can open it; once they say they've submitted it, call ncrypted_request_fulfill to deliver it (e.g. to a Vercel env var) without ever seeing it. Free.

label.description: What you need and why, shown to the user, e.g. 'Stripe secret key for the billing project (Vercel production)'.

ttl_minutes.description: How long the request stays open. Default 60.

name: ncrypted_request
title: Ask the user for a secret
